Dark

--bg #0f0f14 — app canvas
--bg-sidebar #181820 — list + drawer
--bg-chat #0b0b10 — chat pane canvas
--bg-hover rgba(244,244,244,.055) — hover overlay — surfaces only, never text
--bg-active #2b5278 — pressed/active fill
--selection-bg #2b5278 — selected-chat fill — its own token, independent of the outgoing bubble (#182)
--bg-bubble-in #1c1c26 — incoming bubble
--bg-bubble-out #2b5278 — outgoing bubble
--bg-reply rgba(244,244,244,.06) — quote/reply strip
--accent #5aa2e6 — actions and links
--accent-2 #8774e1 — p2p + local chat
--accent-tint #5aa2e6 — translucent selection/pressed fills — per theme
--accent-hover color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 90%, #f4f4f4) — accent fill hover
--accent-active color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, #0b0b10) — accent fill pressed
--on-accent #10131a — ink on accent fills
--accent-text var(--accent) — accent UI text — AA on app surfaces; raw --accent never for normal text in light
--accent-text-in var(--accent) — accent text on incoming bubbles
--focus-ring var(--accent) — keyboard focus outline — one ring color per theme (#182)
--accent-default #5aa2e6 — theme accent for the default swatch
--on-accent-chip #10131a — ink on accent chips
--on-badge #10131a — unread badge ink
--text #f2f2f5 — body ink
--text-dim #8b8b96 — secondary ink
--text-meta-in #8f8f9c — timestamps, incoming
--text-meta-out #a8c6e2 — timestamps, outgoing
--out-link #dfeaf6 — links on the outgoing bubble
--ticks-read #6ec2ff — read receipt ticks
--quote-name var(--accent) — quote sender, incoming
--quote-name-out #d9e9fa — quote sender, outgoing
--green #4fae4f — presence/verified — status, never accent
--danger #e05a5a — destructive
--border rgba(244,244,244,.07) — hairlines
--shadow 0 4px 18px rgba(16,16,16,.45)
--bg-elev #1c1c26 — raised placeholder tiles
--radius-bubble 14px — bubble corner — only per-theme radius token
--head-h 56px — sidebar + chat header (+ safe area)
--list-bar-h calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) — bottom bar (+ safe area)
--font-mono ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace — monospace stack — device info, logs
--call-bg var(--bg-chat) — call screen canvas
--call-fg var(--text) — call screen ink
--call-fg-dim var(--text-dim) — call screen secondary
--call-video-fg #f2f2f5 — ink over live video
--call-scrim color-mix(in srgb, #0b0b10 55%, transparent) — controls scrim over video
--call-btn color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 22%, var(--bg-chat)) — call control fill
--call-btn-on var(--text) — toggled-on call control fill
--call-btn-on-fg var(--bg-chat) — ink on toggled-on control
--call-danger var(--danger) — decline / leave
--call-danger-fg #f4f4f4 — ink on danger control
--call-accept color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 80%, #0b0b10) — accept
--call-accept-fg #f4f4f4 — ink on accept control
--call-avatar-bg #5a6270 — caller avatar fill
--call-avatar-fg #f4f4f4 — caller avatar ink
--call-pip-bg var(--bg-bubble-in) — self-view tile
--call-btn-size 56px — call control diameter
--ui-zoom 1
--vw calc(100vw / var(--ui-zoom))
--vh calc(100vh / var(--ui-zoom))
--dvh calc(100dvh / var(--ui-zoom))
--bubble-inner-max calc(var(--vw) - 120px)
--msg-font-size 15.5px
--radius-tail 6px
--radius-quote 6px
--radius-media 10px
--on-badge-muted #10131a
--ico-1 14px
